title: Tall Stature Women Fetal Weight Estimation
brief_summary: To investigate the difference of clinical VS sonographic fetal weight estimation of tall women stature (above 10t percentile)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women above 172 cm height
* above 39 weeks of gestation

Exclusion Criteria:

* contraindication for vaginal delivery
* Intrauterus growth restriction
